component.name: Pythia
component.summary: Fast, native IDE for Oracle SQL and PL/SQL

description.p: Pythia covers the daily work of an Oracle developer in one responsive, keyboard-first application: writing and running SQL, editing and compiling PL/SQL, debugging, browsing objects, editing data, comparing schemas and monitoring sessions.

ul.li: Code editor with context-aware completion and navigation
Result grids with in-place editing and export to CSV, Excel and more
PL/SQL debugger with breakpoints, stepping and variables
Session monitoring with a blocking tree, AWR/ASH and a trace analyzer
Schema and data compare with sync scripts

description.p: Requires the Oracle Instant Client, which is installed separately.
